QuestInfo.name: Olive Claims Innocence
QuestInfo.0: You've found Olive! Is she really the thief? Listen to her side of the story.
QuestInfo.1: Olive claims to be innocent and is in Ereve searching for evidence to prove it. Rondo appears as you're deciding whether to believe her.
QuestInfo.2: Olive claims to be innocent and is in Ereve searching for evidence to prove it. Rondo appears as you're deciding whether to believe her.
